author: AsmFoundation
name: Assembly + .NET WebAssembly Solution
description: A solution with a .NET WebAssembly app (browser-wasm, run by Node or a browser) and the WebAssembly assembly library it calls through the C# bindings the SDK writes from the library's PROTO lines, linked into the app's runtime. Built by AsmFoundation.Sdk and the .NET SDK with the wasm-tools workload.

SdkVersion.description: The AsmFoundation.Sdk version the assembly project names in its Sdk attribute. Default: the version of this template package, which is released with the SDK of the same version.

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the solution on create.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this solution.
